-- Practice v2 evidence closes a Student-owned binding. Legacy v1 receipts
-- remain readable and retain their original null v2 correlation fields.
ALTER TABLE student_practice_evidence_receipt
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS task_revision_digest varchar(71) NULL,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS workspace_digest varchar(71) NULL,
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS learning_action_id uuid NULL;

ALTER TABLE student_practice_evidence_receipt
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS student_practice_evidence_receipt_policy_version_check,
    ADD CONSTRAINT student_practice_evidence_receipt_policy_version_check CHECK (
        (policy_version = 'practice-competency-evidence-v1'
            AND task_revision_digest IS NULL AND workspace_digest IS NULL AND learning_action_id IS NULL)
        OR
        (policy_version = 'practice-competency-evidence-v2'
            AND task_revision_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
            AND workspace_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
            AND learning_action_id IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_student_practice_evidence_receipt_learning_action
        FOREIGN KEY (learning_action_id) REFERENCES student_learning_action(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_student_practice_evidence_receipt_learning_action_v2
    ON student_practice_evidence_receipt (learning_action_id)
    WHERE learning_action_id IS NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE student_learning_action
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS student_learning_action_source_lifecycle_check;

ALTER TABLE student_learning_action
    ADD CONSTRAINT student_learning_action_source_lifecycle_check CHECK (
        (
            source_kind = 'course_answer'
            AND lifecycle_status IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSED')
            AND student_task_answer_id IS NOT NULL AND task_id IS NOT NULL AND cycle > 0
            AND opened_at IS NOT NULL
            AND ((lifecycle_status = 'OPEN' AND closed_at IS NULL)
                 OR (lifecycle_status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL))
            AND practice_task_instance_id IS NULL AND practice_task_revision_id IS NULL
            AND practice_task_revision_digest IS NULL AND surface_classification IS NULL
            AND learning_path_id IS NULL AND learning_path_version_at_reservation IS NULL
            AND learning_path_position_at_reservation IS NULL AND ensure_request_hash IS NULL
            AND cancel_reason IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
            source_kind = 'practice_v2'
            AND lifecycle_status IN ('RESERVED', 'OPEN', 'CANCELLED', 'CLOSED')
            AND student_task_answer_id IS NULL AND task_id IS NULL AND cycle = 0
            AND practice_task_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND practice_task_revision_id IS NOT NULL
            AND practice_task_revision_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'
            AND surface_classification IN ('practice', 'project')
            AND ensure_request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
            AND context_id = practice_task_instance_id::text
            AND ((surface_classification = 'practice' AND context_type = 'practice_task')
                 OR (surface_classification = 'project' AND context_type = 'project'))
            AND (
                (lifecycle_status = 'RESERVED' AND opened_at IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL
                    AND cancel_reason IS NULL AND evidence_class IS NULL AND outcome IS NULL AND outcome_policy_version IS NULL)
                OR (lifecycle_status = 'OPEN' AND opened_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NULL
                    AND cancel_reason IS NULL AND evidence_class IS NULL AND outcome IS NULL AND outcome_policy_version IS NULL)
                OR (lifecycle_status = 'CANCELLED' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL
                    AND cancel_reason = 'practice_provisioning_failed'
                    AND (opened_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= opened_at)
                    AND evidence_class IS NULL AND outcome IS NULL AND outcome_policy_version IS NULL)
                OR (lifecycle_status = 'CLOSED' AND opened_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_at >= opened_at
                    AND cancel_reason IS NULL AND evidence_class = 'application' AND outcome = 'passed'
                    AND outcome_policy_version = 'student-mastery-v1')
            )
        )
    );

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION student_learning_action_enforce_binding()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.source_kind IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.source_kind THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'student learning action source is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF OLD.source_kind = 'course_answer' THEN
        NEW.lifecycle_status := CASE WHEN NEW.closed_at IS NULL THEN 'OPEN' ELSE 'CLOSED' END;
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    IF OLD.source_kind <> 'practice_v2'
       OR NEW.source_kind <> OLD.source_kind
       OR NEW.student_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.student_id
       OR NEW.student_task_answer_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.student_task_answer_id
       OR NEW.task_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.task_id
       OR NEW.cycle IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.cycle
       OR NEW.context_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.context_type
       OR NEW.context_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.context_id
       OR NEW.learning_targets IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.learning_targets
       OR NEW.practice_task_instance_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.practice_task_instance_id
       OR NEW.practice_task_revision_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.practice_task_revision_id
       OR NEW.practice_task_revision_digest IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.practice_task_revision_digest
       OR NEW.surface_classification IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.surface_classification
       OR NEW.learning_path_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.learning_path_id
       OR NEW.learning_path_version_at_reservation IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.learning_path_version_at_reservation
       OR NEW.learning_path_position_at_reservation IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.learning_path_position_at_reservation
       OR NEW.ensure_request_hash IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.ensure_request_hash THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'student learning action binding is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF (OLD.lifecycle_status = 'RESERVED' AND NEW.lifecycle_status NOT IN ('RESERVED', 'OPEN', 'CANCELLED'))
       OR (OLD.lifecycle_status = 'OPEN' AND NEW.lifecycle_status NOT IN ('OPEN', 'CANCELLED', 'CLOSED'))
       OR (OLD.lifecycle_status IN ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED') AND NEW.lifecycle_status <> OLD.lifecycle_status) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid practice learning action lifecycle transition' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF OLD.lifecycle_status IN ('CANCELLED', 'CLOSED') AND
       (NEW.opened_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.opened_at OR NEW.closed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.closed_at
        OR NEW.cancel_reason IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.cancel_reason OR NEW.evidence_class IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.evidence_class
        OR NEW.outcome IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.outcome OR NEW.outcome_policy_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.outcome_policy_version) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'terminal practice learning action is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;
